QuestInfo.1: You met Moira at the entrance of the Cave of Life and she asked you to defeat Horntail. She said she would make you a secret medicine that transforms you into a dragon for this task. You will need it to pass through the cave entrance guarded by Keroben, Horntail's minion. Return to Moira with all the ingredients.\r\n\r\nTip: Talk to #bMos#k in Leafre to get Cornian's Dagger.
